name: Traveler's Tale
source:
Follow along on the journey of a young writer as she explores the world around her, notebook in hand. With a passion for both travel and storytelling, our heroine sets out on an adventure to experience new cultures, gather inspiration, and craft stories that transport readers to far-off places. Join her as she learns to balance the excitement of discovery with the discipline of writing, and discovers that sometimes the most meaningful story is the one you write for yourself.

[From [url=https://tea-bag-games.itch.io/travelers-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟隨一位年輕作家的旅程，看她手持筆記本，探索周圍的世界。懷著對旅行與講故事的雙重熱愛，女主角踏上冒險，體驗新文化、蒐集靈感，創作能將讀者帶往遙遠國度的故事。陪伴她學會在探索的興奮與寫作的自律之間取得平衡，並發現：有時，最有意義的故事，正是你為自己寫下的那一篇。

[摘自[url=https://tea-bag-games.itch.io/travelers-tale]itch.io[/url]]
